notes: Reviewed all 25 candidates from the saved text files only. Two program-list pages are PhD-level and relevant to the data: the Purdue Strategic Management PhD alumni table (initial placement and current affiliation for 22 named alumni, plus dissertation titles with graduation years 2012-2020; strategy area, to be classified later) and the SMU blog post naming four 2019 PhD in Business job-market candidates whose faculty placements (Bocconi, City University of Hong Kong, Fudan, Peking University) are given only as a set, so the person-to-employer mapping needs another source. The third program-list page is the Rutgers Business School DBA alumni dissertation list (executive DBA, not the PhD; dissertation titles, chairs and graduation months, no placements; one graduate in Operations Research & Supply Chain Management). The TU Clausthal external doctoral candidates page names 14 current (not graduated) doctoral candidates of the Institute of Management and Economics with their outside employers, one in the Operations Research Group; marked not-a-list as a current roster but it may help a roster or later first-job review. All other pages are administrative, student-internship, or bachelor/master thesis pages, or engineering/chemistry department pages outside the population; two TU Darmstadt dissertation pages (CCPS, FZD) captured only an unloaded TUbiblio template. Institutions by host were kept for every page.
